Here is the **U.S. Core Inflation Rate** (Year-over-Year, % change in the Core Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index) from **January 2015 to December 2016**, presented as a markdown table.

| Date       | Core PCE Inflation Rate (%) |
|------------|-----------------------------|
| Jan 2015   | 1.3                         |
| Feb 2015   | 1.4                         |
| Mar 2015   | 1.3                         |

| Nov 2015   | 1.4                         |
| Dec 2015   | 1.4                         |
| Jan 2016   | 1.7                         |
| Feb 2016   | 1.7                         |
| Mar 2016   | 1.6                         |
| Apr 2016   | 1.6                         |

### Notes:
- **Core PCE** excludes volatile food and energy prices, making it the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge.
- Data source: **U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA)**.
- The table shows **year-over-year (YoY) percentage changes**.
